title: Member Pricing by Plan Standing — Alignment Services & Plans Open Work Orders
content:
On an alignment plan of Alignment Services & Plans, the pricing base of the plan's open work order follows the plan's standing. The standing is read from the plan's own records: its cancellation requests, and what its line's term is measured in.

| Plan standing | Pricing base of the open work order |
|---|---|
| The plan has a cancellation request awaiting the holder's confirmation | Member pricing is suspended: the pricing base is the standard single-alignment labor of 109.99, whether or not the interval is reached. |
| A lifetime plan (Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan or Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan Truck & Performance, whose term is measured by vehicle ownership) with no cancellation request awaiting confirmation | The lifetime sliding scale: 0.00 when the interval is reached; otherwise the line's member early-alignment price multiplied by the whole calendar months still to run until the 6-month interval, divided by 6. |
| A month-based plan (Crestline 1-Year Alignment Plan or Crestline 3-Year Alignment Plan) with no cancellation request awaiting confirmation | 0.00 when the interval is reached, and the flat member early-alignment price of the line otherwise. |

**Terms used.** The interval on these plan lines is 6 calendar months or 6000 miles, whichever comes first, measured from the plan's latest included alignment, or from its latest member-early-price alignment when that one is later. The member early-alignment price is 49.99 on the Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan, 59.99 on the Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan Truck & Performance, and 59.99 on the Crestline 1-Year and 3-Year Alignment Plans. A cancellation request awaiting confirmation is one registered on the plan whose status shows it pending the customer's confirmation; a withdrawn or already confirmed request is not one. The sliding-scale figure is not rounded on its own; rounding to the nearest cent applies to the labor charged.

### Sliding scale worked through (hypothetical lifetime visits, no request awaiting confirmation, member early price 49.99)

| Whole months since the interval anchor | Interval reached? | Months still to run | Pricing base |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | No | 6 | 49.99 multiplied by 6, divided by 6: 49.99 |
| 2 | No | 4 | 49.99 multiplied by 4, divided by 6: about 33.33 |
| 5 | No | 1 | 49.99 divided by 6: about 8.33 |
| 6 | Yes | — | 0.00 |
| 3, with the miles interval reached | Yes | — | 0.00 |

**Question:** does a request awaiting confirmation change a visit on which the interval is reached? Yes: member pricing is suspended and the pricing base is the 109.99 standard single-alignment labor whether or not the interval is reached.
